lines: +Playwright supports [subpath imports](https://nodejs.org/api/packages.html#subpath-imports) declared in the `package.json`. Node.js resolves a subpath import to the first target of its mapping, even when that file does not exist. When Node.js fails, Playwright follows TypeScript instead: it tries each target until one resolves, and a `.js` target also matches a `.ts` file with the same name.
